messages.content: Help me output a formatted Java constant declaration for a large Base64 encoded string representing a certificate, with the constant name 'CERTIFICATE' and the value being a 1024-character long Base64 string with 'MIIFdTCCBF2gAwIBAgISESG'?

function.name: LargeHandshakeTest_format

value.description: The value of the Java constant, which will be split into multiple lines if it's too long. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

Then we call the function LargeHandshakeTest_format with name 'CERTIFICATE' and that value. The function will output the formatted constant. So we need to produce a 1024-character string. Let's create a string that starts with 'MIIFdTCCBF2gAwIBAgISESG' and then fill the rest with random characters from Base64 alphabet. The Base64 alphabet includes A-Z, a-z, 0-9, +, /. We can generate 1024 - len(prefix) characters. The prefix length is len('MIIFdTCCBF2gAwIBAgISESG') = let's count: M(1) I(2) I(3) F(4) d(5) T(6) C(7) C(8) B(9) F(10) 2(11) g(12) A(13) w(14) I(15) B(16) A(17) g(18) I(19) S(20) E(21) S(22) G(23). So 23 characters. So we need 1024-23 = 1001 more characters. We'll generate a random string of length 1001 from Base64 alphabet. Then combine. Then call the function.
